baselineOverlay: The uncommitted model-opportunities round, frozen before new changes.
purpose: Resolve three experimental opportunities with production integration gates, independently per model.

execution.downloads: Only the pinned public multilingual-e5-small checkpoint, into an isolated experiment directory; no user preferences or installed model selection changes.

prefix.approach: One helper-owned exact-token-prefix snapshot using pinned official native APIs; full prompt admission and original tool-turn state remain authoritative.
acceptance: Native snapshot restoration reproduces the same split-prefill computation, including recurrent/carried state; inspect any difference from ordinary chunking before native answer claims.
At least 20% median warm first-text improvement in repeated matched pairs; all expected answers correct; include initial preparation in cold latency.
Changed instructions/tools/history/session/model, context overflow, cancellation, sink failure and release invalidate safely. No leaked state across companions or failed tool turns.
One retained snapshot, measured and enforced byte cap. Bounded growing-context/repeated-release controls show no accumulating allocations.
Production conversation/tool workflows preserve correctness and streamed/final output agreement. Unsupported profiles stay disabled.

candidates: Apple contextual embeddings from previous round as reference
Native multilingual-e5-small with documented retrieval prefixes and masked mean pooling
acceptance: Frozen broader paraphrase, cross-language, exact identifier, ownership and negative cases; expected identities never enter the inference process.
Improved held-out recall without exact identifier regressions, evaluated with both full questions and normal tool keywords. No universal score cutoff selected on test answers.
Negative retrieval candidates are evidence candidates, not answers: end-to-end tests must refuse unsupported personal assertions.
Production promotion additionally requires a versioned derived index, atomic correction/deletion visibility, bounded background work, lexical fallback, restart/cancellation tests and measured scale.

splitWrites.candidate: Create-only save_memory, required-reference replace_memory, and one general instruction to handle explicit durable assertions alongside questions. No case-specific examples or automatic intent guesses.
splitWrites.acceptance: At least two additional complete screen tasks against the fixed prior baseline, preserved source/general controls, no unauthorized write/provenance loss or false save acknowledgement. Qualifiers require two paired confirmation repetitions plus reserved cases. Otherwise revert.

review.reviewer: Implementing agent; not independent or blinded
review.stop: Stop each candidate on a mandatory acceptance failure after investigating the integration; stop native execution when the budget cannot admit the next bounded batch. Do not lower a gate after seeing scores.
